title: PA-GEI: Part-Aware Gait Energy Images
description: PyTorch code for PA-GEI, a silhouette-based gait recognition method that splits the Gait Energy Image into horizontal strips before feature extraction and encodes each strip with its own lightweight CNN. CASIA-B data are not included; request them from the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences.
